statement: Every smooth Hausdorff second-countable finite-dimensional manifold without boundary with positive-definite smooth metric and mutually dual torsion-free smooth affine connections has a proper smooth statistical embedding into an open subset of R^N with a positive-definite Hessian metric and both correctly ordered induced flat torsion-free dual connections, where N=binomial(2n+4,3) for n>=1.
necessity: For arbitrary smooth mutually dual connection pairs, torsion-freeness of both is necessary for realization by orthogonal projection from a torsion-free dually flat statistical ambient manifold.
historical_scope: FMU item 1(a), read with its cited Amari 1997 definition, requires neither ambient convexity/completeness nor globally injective dual coordinates. The accepted theorem supplies the global finite-dimensional geometric realization in that sense.
explicit_nonclaims: A finite probability-simplex or fixed linear-statistical model
review_coverage: Full coordinate compatibility and the normal-coordinate cubic factor
Finite global scalar 3-jet spanning family and proper feature embedding
Smooth bundle right inverse without a uniform singular-value estimate
Exact zero-period conormal pair and both connection identities
Euclidean normal-bundle extension without a global normal frame
Smooth pointwise Schur correction and a single positive-Hessian open neighborhood
Torsion-freeness and local affine-coordinate proof of dual flatness
Metric pullback and correct ordering of both induced connections
Noncompact, disconnected, and separately stated zero-dimensional cases
independence: The full proof was reconstructed rather than inferred from test success. No other independent audit was accessed, and the candidate verification programs were neither read nor executed. The supplemental controls were authored independently and then rerun against the exact frozen packet.
documentary_notes: Whitney Theorem 1 on printed p.654, alongside Lemma 19 and footnote 32 on p.665, makes the smooth proper-embedding citation particularly clear.
Amari 1997 pp.84-87 gives a direct primary-source trail for the torsion-free and local-coordinate interpretation. Both notes are optional citation improvements; neither changes the proof.
manuscript_status: Authored proof with a passing independent mathematical audit A. This record is not journal acceptance and does not assert a completed second independent audit.
